text.description_html:
Deltana 55D2014, Wall Mounted Tooth Brush Holder with White Frosted Glass Tumbler

The Modern White Frosted Glass Wall Mounted Tooth Brush Holder is a great solution for your bathroom storage needs. It is easy to install and can display toothbrushes, combs, or even make-up brushes in an organized and modern way. The Wall Mounted Tooth Brush Holder has a white frosted glass tumbler and a solid brass wall mount. The wall mount is available in your choice of contemporary finish. The glass cup is removable for easy cleaning.

Shop more of the Deltana 55D Series Bathroom Accessories

Features and Specifications of the Modern Frosted Glass Tumbler Set:

  • Material: Solid Brass wall mount with a glass cup.
  • Glass Color: Frosted White
  • Overall Projection: 4-5/8"
  • Cup Height: 3-7/8"
  • Cup Width (at lip): 3-5/8" square
  • Mount Height: 1-1/4"
  • Mount Width: 1-7/8"
  • Deltana 55D2014 Tooth Brush Holder Specifications (PDF)

Sold Individually. Package includes: 1 tooth brush holder, mounting screw cover, and all necessary mounting screws.

This is a Limited Series. Limited Quantities Available
